selection.stratum_rule: balanced across CEFR A1-C2, POS variety, difficulty, category
selection.exclusion_rule: excluded the 14/160 entries with legitimate-null core fields (mnemonic_ar for no-hook words, word_family for function words) to ensure clean A/B comparison

selection_bias.reason: 14/160 golden entries have legitimate-null core fields (mnemonic_ar=null for no-hook words, word_family=null for function words). These were excluded to keep the pilot's A/B comparison clean (no null-handling ambiguity).
selection_bias.implication: PILOT-15-V1 therefore evaluates enrichment quality on NON-NULL-CAPABLE entries ONLY. It does NOT validate null behavior or null-generation discipline. Null-capable words MUST be re-introduced in the 100-word pilot before the null-default rule can be judged.
selection_bias.direction_of_bias: Excluding null-capable words biases the pilot toward configurations that produce MORE content (especially mnemonics), because every pilot word is expected to carry a mnemonic. A configuration with disciplined nulls will not be fairly rewarded here.
